summary: Charming Medical Limited, a Hong Kong-based TCM therapies provider trading as MCTA on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Staff delisting determination letter dated October 29, 2026, issued under Listing Rule IM-5101-4 following the SEC's November 11, 2025 trading suspension tied to alleged social-media manipulation by unknown third parties. No price, stake, premium, advisor or recommendation terms are stated. Absent an appeal by November 5, 2026, trading suspends at the open on November 9, 2026, and Nasdaq will file Form 25-NSE. Watch appeal filing, OTC quotation prospects and liquidity risk.
